$comment: STRUCTURE HAND-AUTHORED, PAYLOAD TRANSLITERATED FROM THE XML FIXTURE'S OWN BYTES (DEV-013). Rule 10 forbids generating a fixture with the code under test, and at 360000 cells it also forbids typing one. The header, layout, substrate and BinCodeMap metadata below are transcribed by hand from v0211-perf-600x600-ascii.xml, which is where the meaning lives. The 600 BinCode rows are lifted verbatim from that file's TEXT with a regex - never through parseE142Xml and never through e142DocumentToJson, either of which would make the equivalence assertion a restatement of itself. The XML fixture is itself script-generated and says so; this is the same method its own verify_perf_fixtures.py uses, reading the emitted text rather than a generator's memory. Payload: deterministic round-wafer mask, 80996 null cells outside the circle, 273496 Pass and 5508 Fail inside it - counted from the rows written here, not from the generator.
